row.body: A receipt groups fuel, clothing, food, and a vehicle under one pickup. The receiving signature is missing, though every stop is checked.
row.title: Four stops on one receipt

sidecar.gloss: Several supply stops are checked without a receiving signature.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program crew could have collected supplies for a field site; the unchecked signature does not identify the buyer.

row.body: the box of matches and hand torch smell sharply of bleach. mud outlines between them show that a third object was removed.
row.title: missing count beside the box of matches

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

row.body: Laundry receipt: coveralls from the second circle carried orange pollen from the test rows. The clerk noted numb fingers before patrol cars reached the highway.
